title: Kemble Widmer II, Early Furniture Collector & Scholar, 85 - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
snippet: Submitted by The Family. NEWBURYPORT, MASS. — Kemble Widmer II, age 85, of Newburyport passed away on April 12, 2026, surrounded by his loving family.
